name: Kozhikode
tagline: Calicut, the city of spices and sailors
summary: Kozhikode: Calicut's spice-port history, Kappad beach, Beypore boat-building, Mishkal Mosque, halwa and the Sargaalaya craft village.

history.overview: Kozhikode was the capital of the Zamorins and a premier spice port. Vasco da Gama landed nearby in 1498. Beypore's wooden ship-builders still craft traditional boats.

timeline.event: Visited by Ibn Battuta and Chinese fleets.

bestTime.why: Pleasant for beaches and food trails.
